opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Aims to secure temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements.
opportunities.summary: Rescue fellowship programme helping academics in immediate danger of imminent imprisonment, injury or death to find temporary refuge in universities and research institutions (mostly in the UK). Provides 2- or 3-year awards as standard, including financial support, placement negotiation, visa help and practical arrangements for the academic and accompanying family members. Applications are considered on a rolling basis.
